The addition creates a second writer of one capability rather than extending the first, so a policy repair to one can miss the other. The plan's done_when sanctioned leaving paid_lanes untouched while it is held by another run and the manifest records it under follow_ons, so this blocks nothing here; it is the fold the follow-on names.
